instrument_defects: 29 of the 32 UNSUPPORTED rows were judged fresh in the P3 campaign but recorded the adjudicator's reason as 'x' — the instrument's reason field was not maintained; this file supplies the reasons from a full re-read

8 WRONG_RELATION rows (CIP-005-7 x4, CIP-010-4, CIP-013-2 x2, CIP-006-6) carry the reason text in wrong_relation_should_be and the correct relation only inside that reason text — fields transposed; the intended correction (REFERENCES) is unambiguous in every case
taxonomy_note: Sharper question applied: is the quote insufficient for ANY relation, or sufficient for a weaker one? Result: of 32 UNSUPPORTED, exactly 1 is a relation over-claim (a traceability row that NAMES its requirement — sufficient for REFERENCES); the demonstrated over-claim pattern lives in the WRONG_RELATION set (13 traceability rows claimed as IMPLEMENTS). The 31 confirmed-unsupported split into wrong-requirement contamination (13 — the quote performs a DIFFERENT Part's or standard's duty), scope/purpose statements (7), too-coarse cross-reference or TOC rows (6), and under-specific claims that state the genus or the governance rather than the Part's specific demand (5).
